displayName: 海猪·小步 Sea Pig Trundle
description: Original Scotoplanes-inspired Sea Pig Trundle companion, with soft tube-foot walking waves, oral-tentacle greeting, careful pebble stepping and a gentle buoyant leaf-tray rise. The six pairs of feet and two pairs of dorsal papillae are a simplified original design with view-dependent occlusion, not a species reconstruction or popularity claim.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
